package.description: Free open-source (Apache-2.0) edition of miPDFsign — a tablet signature app that embeds handwritten signatures with biometric data as PAdES into PDFs.

en-US.description: Free open-source (Apache-2.0) edition of miPDFsign — a tablet signature app that embeds handwritten signatures with biometric data as PAdES into PDFs.
en-US.longDescription:
miPDFsign Community is the free, open-source (Apache-2.0) edition of miPDFsign, a .NET 8 WPF
application for signature tablets. It captures handwritten signatures together with biometric
pressure data and embeds them as PAdES signatures (Baseline B/T/LT/LTA) into PDF documents,
including QES via ID Austria. It uses the open-source PDF engine miPDFlib (Apache-2.0). A commercial edition with
additional features is available on request.
en-US.name: miPDFsign Community
